description: This Java class 'UserService' provides user management functionality within a book tracking application, including registration, authentication, user details updates, password management, and account locking. It interacts with repositories, handles validation, security, and exception management, and uses various dependencies to implement core user-related operations.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class providing user account management, including registration, authentication, credential updates, account locking, and related user operations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user after validating input, checking for existing email, encrypting password, and authenticating the user.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Creates a new User entity with assigned default role and encrypted password.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user from security context.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all users (possibly for testing or administrative purposes).

methods.name: findUserById
methods.description: Finds a user by their ID, returning an Optional<User>.

methods.name: findUserByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by email address, returning an Optional<User>.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs authentication given a user, updating the security context.

methods.name: isEmailInUse
methods.description: Checks if a given email is already associated with an existing user.

methods.name: changeUserEmail
methods.description: Updates the email of a user after verifying the current password and ensuring the email isn't already taken.

methods.name: isPasswordStrengthVeryStrong
methods.description: Evaluates if a password has very strong strength based on ZXCVBN scoring.

methods.name: isPasswordTooWeak
methods.description: Checks if the password strength is below the threshold.

methods.name: changeUserPassword
methods.description: Changes user's password after validating its strength and encrypting it.

methods.name: deleteUserById
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID after removing associated predefined shelves and their books.

methods.name: passwordIsIncorrect
methods.description: Checks if the provided password does not match the current user's password.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelfFromUserBooks
methods.description: Removes predefined shelves from user books before user deletion.

methods.name: increaseFailAttempts
methods.description: Increments count of failed login attempts for a user.

methods.name: resetFailAttempts
methods.description: Resets the failed login attempts counter.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a user account and records lock time for potential unlock after lock duration.

methods.name: hoursUntilUnlock
methods.description: Calculates hours remaining until account unlock based on lock time.

methods.name: unlockWhenTimeExpired
methods.description: Unlocks a user account if the lock duration has elapsed.
